name: Lost at Sea
source:
Maribel Hearn and Renko Usami go on a date to a supposedly haunted museum ship. This can, of course, only go well.

[From [url=https://pointyshades.itch.io/lost-at-sea]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛丽贝尔·赫恩和宇佐见莲子去一艘据称闹鬼的博物馆船约会。当然，这只能顺利进行。

[来自[url=https://pointyshades.itch.io/lost-at-sea]itch.io[/url]]
